capabilities: Generate articles from knowledge fragments in notes
Choose the target language of the generated article
Replace the original note with the generated article
extras: The README claims support for multiple providers but states that only OpenAI is currently supported; no usage examples or screenshots are included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn scattered knowledge fragments in notes into a finished article, which normally requires manual drafting.

relations.evidence: It simplely uses the LLM APIs(now only support OpenAI) to generate articles

summary: AI writing plugin that generates articles from knowledge fragments in your notes using LLM APIs, currently OpenAI only.
